$comment: Per-dialect capability descriptor. An agent reads this AFTER the http-mcp transports tool tells it WebRTC is adapter-provided. Declares how this dialect maps down onto the wire's two atoms.

maps_to.session: CHANNEL (bidi_command) — one held, reliable, ordered DataChannel; the node produces text commands and consumes responses and peer events
maps_to.signaling: adapter-owned setup CALL (httpx.Do) — POST application/sdp with gathered ICE candidates; receive application/sdp answer; SDP/ICE/DTLS/SCTP negotiation never enters the wire API
maps_to.commands: frames on the CHANNEL — {id,method,params}, matching bidi_command; BidiCommand returns the matching id and delivers unmatched frames to an optional event callback
maps_to.events: frames on the CHANNEL — unsolicited peer text messages, available through ReadText or the command's event callback

capability_shaped: Pion WebRTC: real SDP offer/answer, non-trickle ICE gathering, candidate connectivity checks, DTLS fingerprint verification, SCTP and DCEP
one reliable, ordered DataChannel per peer connection; label configured on both nodes
wsx-style WriteText/ReadText/SetDeadline/Close; serialized writes, one reader, 64 KiB maximum text message, binary messages skipped on reads
bounded negotiation and signaling bodies; signaling server Close tears down its peers; caller closes the dialed channel
per-node STUN/TURN configuration including TURN credentials; empty server list uses host candidates only
explicit loopback-only mode excludes non-loopback local and remote ICE candidates and disables multicast DNS
why_not_wire: SDP/ICE/DTLS/SCTP negotiation and NAT traversal are session capability, not a new transport shape. The adapter carries out a small httpx signaling CALL and presents the resulting held duplex DataChannel as CHANNEL (bidi_command). Signaling is setup, not a second exposed wire atom. The wire never sees SDP. Media/SRTP is not implemented by this DataChannel adapter.

per_node: -listen -signal-path / WEBRTC_LISTEN WEBRTC_SIGNAL_PATH (answer: explicit bind address and path)
-ice-servers / WEBRTC_ICE_SERVERS (JSON array of urls, username, credential; empty = no STUN/TURN)
config.hardcoded: no signaling endpoint, bind address, signaling path or ICE/STUN/TURN server

shape_proven_by: webrtc_test.go and loopback webrtc — own both real Pion peers, exchange an offer/answer on localhost via one httpx CALL, then close the signaling HTTP server and exchange three id-matched CHANNEL commands plus a peer event over ICE/DTLS/SCTP. Only loopback candidates, no external STUN. Also tests deadlines, close, malformed signaling, cancellation and concurrent writers. The answer CLI is an explicit echo demonstration; applications install their own NewSignaler handler.
